drinkWater.history.name: Drink History
drinkWater.dismiss.title: Record a Cup (Default Size)
drinkWater.add.title: Record a Drink (Choose Size)
drinkWater.remindNow.title: Show Drink Water Reminder Now
drinkWater.resetAll.title: Reset All Drink Records
drinkWater.resetToday.title: Reset Today's Drink Records
drinkWater.togglePause.title: Pause/Resume Drink Water Countdown
drinkWater.blocker.description: Full-screen page that fills the editor, re-opens if you try to close it, and needs a confirm click.
drinkWater.redAlert.description: Switch VS Code to the red color theme when it's time to drink, restore after you confirm.
drinkWater.confirmDelaySeconds.descripti: How long the blocker's confirm button stays disabled (seconds). 0 = immediately clickable.
drinkWater.mlPerCup.description: Milliliters added to the daily total each time you record a cup. Default 350ml.
drinkWater.cupSizes.description: Available cup sizes for the drink picker, in ml.
drinkWater.fastDrinkMode.description: If enabled, record a drink immediately as mlPerCup without showing the cup-size picker.
drinkWater.milestones.description: Milliliter milestones that fire a celebration toast when crossed.
drinkWater.snoozeMinutes.description: How long the blocker's Snooze button postpones the reminder (minutes).
drinkWater.bounceLogo.description: Show a bouncing DVD-style logo panel when it's time to drink (closes by itself after 20s).
drinkWater.idlePauseMinutes.description: Auto-pause the countdown when you've been idle (no typing) this many minutes. 0 = off.
drinkWater.language.description: Language of the built-in reminder messages. 'auto' follows the VS Code display language.
drinkWater.messages.description: Reminder messages, shown in turn. Leave empty to use the built-in messages; add your own in any language.
